Operational base in Gurugram, Haryana; legal domicile in Mauritius; founded 2000. Listed on Nasdaq (MMYT), with Trip.com Group and Naspers/Prosus as major shareholders. Very well known consumer travel brand in India, and an active cricket and sports advertiser.

Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics company, handling parcels, freight and express services for e-commerce, enterprises and SMEs through a network of fulfilment centres and a large fleet. Handles hundreds of millions of shipments each year. Headquartered in Gurugram; founded 2011. Listed on the NSE and BSE (DELHIVERY) since 2022, with SoftBank, Carlyle and Fosun among backers. B2B brand known to Indian online shoppers.

Zepto is a Mumbai-based Indian quick-commerce company founded in 2021, delivering groceries and household goods to customers in about 10 minutes from dark stores in major cities. Its app serves millions of urban consumers and earns from product margins, delivery and advertising, with funding of about $2.5bn including raises led by Motilal Oswal and Nexus, valuing it near $7bn in 2025. Private. Strong urban consumer brand in India, with heavy marketing including IPL cricket advertising.

GoTo Group is an Indonesian technology group formed by the 2021 merger of Gojek and Tokopedia, based in Jakarta. It runs ride-hailing, food delivery, e-commerce, logistics and financial services (GoPay) in Indonesia and Southeast Asia, earning commissions, advertising and payment fees. It serves tens of millions of consumers and millions of driver partners and merchants. Listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (GOTO), with Grab merger talks reported. Huge consumer brand in Indonesia, with sports and event sponsorships.

Blinkit (formerly Grofers) is a Gurugram quick-commerce platform delivering groceries, electronics and household goods to customers in around 10 minutes from dark stores across hundreds of Indian cities. It earns product margin, delivery and advertising revenue. Acquired by Zomato in 2022, now part of Eternal Ltd, which is listed on the NSE and BSE. Strong urban consumer brand in India with heavy advertising, including around cricket.

PODS is a Clearwater, Florida portable moving and storage company that delivers storage containers to homes and businesses, then picks them up and moves or stores them, operating in the US, Canada and Australia. Founded in 1998, it earns from container rentals, moves and storage, and uses franchise and licensee partners. Owned by Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan since 2021. Private. Recognisable consumer-facing brand in North America with mass-market advertising.

YTO Express is a Shanghai-based Chinese express parcel delivery company, one of the country's largest couriers, handling billions of parcels a year for e-commerce sellers and consumers through a network of franchised outlets and sorting hubs. It earns delivery fees and is part of the Alibaba-linked courier ecosystem, and its parent is Yuantong Express. Listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (600233). B2B and B2C logistics brand, well known in China, with little profile abroad.

Kroger is the largest traditional supermarket operator in the US, headquartered in Cincinnati, running about 2,700 stores under banners such as Kroger, Ralphs, Fred Meyer, Harris Teeter and King Soopers, plus fuel centres, pharmacies and private-label brands like Simple Truth. Annual sales are near $150bn with around 410,000 employees. Listed on the NYSE (KR). Its attempt to merge with Albertsons failed in 2024. Very high US consumer awareness; it sponsors sports and community events regionally.

MTR Corporation operates Hong Kong's metro network and rail services, plus railways in mainland China, London (Elizabeth line), Stockholm, Sydney and Melbourne, and earns from fares, property development and station retail. It carries millions of passengers a day. Majority-owned by the Hong Kong government, with an HQ in Kowloon, and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (0066). Ubiquitous brand to Hong Kong commuters with strong local awareness, and a sponsor of local events.

Canadian National Railway (CN) is a Montreal-based freight railroad running about 19,500 route miles across Canada and down to the US Gulf Coast, hauling intermodal containers, grain, coal, forest products, petroleum and automobiles. Revenue is around C$17bn with about 24,000 employees. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (CNR/CNI) and widely held, with Bill Gates a notable investor. B2B freight railway with strong Canadian industry recognition but little consumer awareness.

CPKC (Canadian Pacific Kansas City) is a Calgary-based railway created in 2023 when Canadian Pacific acquired Kansas City Southern, forming the only single-line rail network connecting Canada, the US and Mexico. It moves grain, automotive, intermodal, energy and industrial goods and also runs the CPKC Holiday Train. Revenue is about C$14bn. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (CP). B2B freight railway, with a mid-level public profile in Canada.

Delek Logistics Partners is a Brentwood, Tennessee master limited partnership that owns pipelines, terminals, storage and trucking assets, handling crude oil and refined products mainly for its sponsor Delek US Holdings, in Texas, Arkansas, Tennessee and other states. It earns fee-based revenue and pays distributions to unit holders. Listed on the NYSE (DKL). B2B midstream, no consumer brand.

ESR Group is a pan-Asia-Pacific logistics real estate developer, owner and fund manager based in Singapore (with Hong Kong operations), with a portfolio of warehouses and data centers and fund management of over $150bn of assets. Customers are e-commerce, retail and logistics tenants, and income comes from rent, development and fees. Taken private in 2025 by a consortium including Starwood Capital, Warburg Pincus and Sixth Street, after Hong Kong listing (1821). B2B property, no consumer profile.

Goodman Group is an Australian industrial property group based in Sydney that owns, develops and manages logistics warehouses, business parks and increasingly data centers in Australia, New Zealand, Asia, Europe, the UK, North America and the Middle East. It manages billions of dollars of assets for institutional investors and earns development and fees income. Listed on the ASX (GMG). B2B real estate firm with no consumer brand awareness.

International Distribution Services is the parent of Royal Mail and General Logistics Systems (GLS), a London-based postal and parcel group delivering letters and parcels in the UK and across Europe and Canada. It had revenue over GBP 12bn and about 140,000 employees. In 2025 it was acquired by Czech billionaire Daniel Kretinsky's EP Group for about GBP 3.6bn and delisted from the London Stock Exchange. Royal Mail is a very well-known UK consumer brand.

Prologis is the world's largest industrial real estate investment trust, based in San Francisco, owning and leasing roughly 1.3 billion square feet of logistics warehouses in 20 countries to retailers, e-commerce, third-party logistics and manufacturing firms such as Amazon. Revenue is around $8bn. It also builds data centers and energy projects. Listed on the NYSE (PLD). B2B landlord with low consumer awareness.

J&T Express is an Indonesian-born express delivery company, headquartered in Jakarta, operating a franchised parcel network across Southeast Asia, China, Brazil, Mexico, the Middle East and Africa, handling billions of parcels a year for e-commerce sellers and consumers. It listed in Hong Kong (1519) in 2023. Backed by Sequoia, Hillhouse, Boyu, Tencent and Alibaba-linked investors. A familiar e-commerce logistics brand across Southeast Asia, with football and other sponsorships.

Big Brand Tire and Service is a Moorpark, California tire and auto service retailer, with dozens of stores in California and the Western US, selling tires, wheels, brakes and repairs to consumers and fleets. It is private, owned by PE-backed Mavis-style consolidators. The input shows funding of about $1.6bn, which probably reflects a transaction or debt. Local consumer brand with moderate regional recognition.

BigBasket is a Bengaluru-based Indian online grocery and supermarket business offering scheduled and quick delivery of fruit, vegetables, groceries and household goods in more than 25 Indian cities. Tata Digital bought a majority stake in 2021 and it is part of the Tata Group, with Alibaba and Abraaj as earlier investors. Revenue is around INR 100bn. Private. Strong urban consumer brand in India with substantial advertising.

Coca-Cola Consolidated is a Charlotte, North Carolina bottler and distributor, the largest independent Coca-Cola bottler in the US, producing and distributing Coca-Cola products, plus other brands, in about 14 states across the southeast, mid-Atlantic and Midwest. Revenue is near $7bn. Controlled by chairman J. Frank Harrison III, and listed on Nasdaq (COKE). B2B2C distributor with local branding, and the Coca-Cola logo on products; the bottler name itself is not a consumer brand.

Cosan is a Brazilian holding company in Sao Paulo with stakes in energy, fuel, logistics and agriculture. It holds interests in Raizen (fuel and sugar-ethanol joint venture with Shell), Rumo (rail logistics), Compass gas and Moove lubricants, which sells Mobil-licensed lubricants. Customers are industrial, retail and fuel distribution. Listed on B3 (CSAN3) and the NYSE (CSAN). Moove sponsors in motorsport in some markets, but the group mostly has B2B and local awareness.

Mitsui & Co is a Tokyo-based general trading company (sogo shosha), one of Japan's big five, founded 1876 and active in energy, metals, machinery, chemicals, food, healthcare and mobility. It makes money by trading, project investments and equity-accounted businesses, with operations in about 60 countries and tens of thousands of staff. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (8031). Customers are corporates and governments; B2B, brand known in business and Japan but little consumer recognition.

Gruppo Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane is Italy's state-owned railway group, headquartered in Rome, running passenger rail (Trenitalia, including Frecciarossa high-speed), rail infrastructure (RFI) and road operations (Anas), plus operations in the UK, Germany, Spain and Greece. Revenue is about 15 billion euros with more than 90,000 employees. State-owned by the Italian Ministry of Economy. Very high consumer brand awareness in Italy, with sports sponsorship such as Trenitalia and Frecciarossa partnerships.

HelloFresh is a Berlin-based meal-kit company founded in 2011, delivering boxes of recipes and pre-portioned ingredients to subscribers in the US, Europe, Canada, Australia and Japan under HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Factor and YouFoodz. Revenue is about 7.5 billion euros with millions of active customers. Listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (HFG). High consumer brand awareness, heavy advertiser, and has sponsored sports including football in Germany.

about: Aramex is a Dubai-based logistics and express delivery company founded in 1982, offering courier, freight forwarding, warehousing and e-commerce fulfilment across the Middle East, Africa, Asia and beyond. Customers are businesses and online shoppers. Revenue is about 1.5 billion dollars, with an AED 2 billion funding figure reported in the input. Listed on the Dubai Financial Market (ARMX); Abu Dhabi's Abu Dhabi Ports (AD Ports) became majority owner of Aramex in 2025. Visible brand in the Gulf.

Transnet SOC Ltd is South Africa's state-owned freight transport and logistics company, headquartered in Johannesburg, operating the country's freight rail network, ports (Durban, Cape Town and others) and pipelines. It is owned by the South African government and has issued large debt. Customers are miners, importers and exporters, and shippers. B2B state-owned enterprise, with moderate public visibility in South Africa.

Agility is a Dubai-based logistics and supply chain group, with roots in Kuwait (Agility Public Warehousing), that provides freight forwarding, warehousing, industrial parks, and infrastructure services and owns Menzies Aviation stakes and Tristar. Customers are businesses and governments across the Middle East, Asia and Africa. It has reported funding of about $2.5 billion. B2B, little consumer brand awareness.

about: Akiem is a Paris-based European rail leasing company and one of the leading lessors of locomotives to rail operators and freight companies across Europe, founded in 2008 by SNCF-related and investor partners. It earns lease and service revenue. The input shows about 1.5 billion in funding. B2B with no consumer brand awareness.

about: Costamare is a Monaco-based shipping company, listed on NYSE (CMRE), that owns and charters containerships and dry bulk vessels, with a fleet of around 100 vessels leased to liner companies such as MSC, COSCO and ONE. It is founded by the Konstantakopoulos family of Greece. Reported funding about $1.75 billion. B2B shipping with no consumer brand awareness.

Global Partners LP is a Waltham, Massachusetts-based master limited partnership (NYSE: GLP) that stores, distributes and markets petroleum products, renewable fuels, natural gas and propane, and operates convenience stores and gas stations (Alltown, Sunoco-branded sites) in the Northeast and mid-Atlantic. Revenue is around $17 billion. Customers are wholesale, commercial and retail fuel customers. Consumer-facing via its gas stations, but little corporate brand awareness.

Motiva is a Brazilian mobility and infrastructure concession company (formerly CCR, rebranded in 2025), headquartered in Sao Paulo, operating toll roads, airports, urban rail and metro lines (such as Viaquatro and VLT) in Brazil. It is listed on the B3 exchange (MOTV3). The input reports funding of about 13.9 billion reais. Customers are drivers and commuters. High consumer visibility in Brazil via roads and transit, with some sports sponsorship.

SmartStop Self Storage is a Ladera Ranch, California self-storage real estate investment trust (NYSE: SMA, listed 2025), owning and operating more than 200 self-storage facilities in the US and Canada under the SmartStop and Strategic Storage brands. It earns rental income from consumer and business tenants. Reported funding about $1.8 billion. Consumer-facing local storage brand with modest national awareness.

WestConnex is a Sydney, Australia motorway project, one of the largest transport infrastructure projects in the country, delivering the M4, M8 and M5 tunnel links, built by the NSW government and now owned by Sydney Transport Partners (Transurban consortium) after the 2018 sale of a majority stake. Revenue comes from tolls. The input shows reported funding in Australian dollars, about 3.2 billion. High local visibility in Sydney as a toll road; Transurban is the operating brand.

JD Logistics is the logistics arm of JD.com, headquartered in Beijing and listed in Hong Kong (2618) since 2021. It provides warehousing, express delivery, freight and supply chain technology to JD.com and external clients across China and overseas, with hundreds of warehouses and over 500,000 staff including couriers. Revenue is above 150 billion yuan, mainly from logistics services. Founded 2007 inside JD.com. Strong consumer-facing brand in China through deliveries, though largely B2B abroad.

Getir is a Turkish ultra-fast grocery delivery company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Istanbul, delivering groceries and food in minutes from dark stores, and also operating GetirFood and GetirWater. Peak valuation was about 12 billion dollars in 2022, backed by Mubadala and Sequoia, before it withdrew from Europe and the US in 2023-24 and restructured. Money comes from order margins and fees. Strong consumer brand in Turkey, with past sponsorship of football and basketball.

Stord is a US commerce enablement company that provides fulfilment, warehousing, freight and software for e-commerce and consumer brands, with a national network of warehouses and a cloud platform for inventory and order management. Headquartered in Atlanta, it was founded in 2015 and has raised several hundred million dollars from venture investors. Customers are direct-to-consumer and retail brands. B2B logistics technology with little public brand awareness.

about: UPS (United Parcel Service) is the world's largest package delivery company, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia and listed on the NYSE (UPS). It delivers around 20 million packages a day across more than 200 countries and territories with about 500,000 employees, a large delivery fleet and aircraft, plus supply chain, freight and healthcare logistics. Revenue is around 90 billion dollars. Founded 1907. Very strong consumer and business brand with a history of sports sponsorship, including NASCAR.

Ninja Van is a Singapore-founded last-mile logistics and courier company founded in 2014, delivering e-commerce parcels, same-day and cross-border shipments in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines and Myanmar. Customers are online merchants such as Shopee and Lazada sellers and consumers. Backed by Alibaba, B Capital, Temasek-linked and other investors, with a valuation of about 1 billion dollars. Visible to consumers through red delivery vans and branding, although mainly B2B.

Rohlik Group is a Czech online grocery delivery group headquartered in Prague, operating Rohlik.cz, Knuspr in Germany, Kifli in Hungary, Gurkerl in Austria and Sezamo in Italy and Spain. Founded 2014 by Tomas Cupr, it delivers fresh groceries from its own warehouses to hundreds of thousands of customers, with revenue near 2 billion euros. Investors include Index Ventures and Sofina. Strong consumer brand in its home markets.

Detroit Manufacturing Systems is a Detroit, Michigan automotive manufacturing and logistics company. According to the input it works in automotive manufacturing and logistics-related services. Customers, products, ownership and scale are not confirmed here, and it should be checked carefully since similar names exist. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: JOKR is a quick-commerce grocery company that operates an AI-enabled online supermarket delivering groceries in minutes from dark stores in Brazil, after earlier launches in the US, Mexico and other Latin American markets. Founded 2020 by Ralf Wenzel, it raised venture funding at a valuation of about 1.2 billion dollars before scaling back and focusing on Brazil. Customers are urban households. Consumer app brand with moderate awareness in Brazilian cities. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Royal Mail is the UK's national postal and parcel operator, founded 1516 and headquartered in London, delivering letters and parcels to 32 million addresses six days a week, plus its Parcelforce and international operations. It is owned by International Distribution Services (IDS), listed in London until Czech businessman Daniel Kretinsky's EP Group acquired it in 2025. Revenue is about 12 billion pounds. Very strong consumer brand across the UK.

Genesee & Wyoming is a US owner of short line and regional freight railroads, headquartered in Darien, Connecticut, operating more than 100 railroads in North America, Australia and Europe. It was acquired in 2019 by Brookfield Infrastructure and GIC after being listed on the NYSE, and now serves industrial customers hauling commodities and goods. Founded 1899. B2B transport company with no consumer visibility.
